warnings: THIS IS THE ONLY PLACE IN THE ARCHITECTURAL SET THAT SPECIFIES REINFORCEMENT. RB 9 มม.@0.15 ม.# in a cast counter is architectural detailing, not structure, and it does not appear on any S sheet. It is recorded here as the counter's own rebar rather than being merged into the structural files, and RB matches the S-01 material note for ø9 (SR-24 round bar).

The 0.20 m dimension is the counter's section depth, the only dimension printed on the detail apart from the 15 mm stone. No plan length is given - the counter's extent comes from the ห้องน้ำ 1 plan on the same sheet.
The same counter detail is referenced from ห้องน้ำ 2 and 3 by the TOP หินแกรนิต note on their sheets, but is drawn only here.
